name: memail_accounts
description: List the user's connected mailboxes. Returns { accounts: [{ id (UUID), email, provider, imap_host, mailbox, status ('active'|'auth_error'|'disabled'), last_synced_at, last_error }] }. Use an account `id` to scope memail_list to one mailbox, and check `status` — an 'auth_error' mailbox has stopped syncing (its app password likely needs re-entering) so its cached mail may be stale. Never returns any credential. Takes no parameters.
